question: When did India host the Asian Games for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1951**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi, India in 1951**.
 
• The event marked the beginning of a major continental multi-sport event for athletes from across Asia.
 
• It was the first time India hosted such a large-scale sports event, setting a precedent for future games.
 
• The Asian Games are held every four years, bringing together athletes from all over Asia to compete in various sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games**

 
 
• The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The first Asian Games were held in New Delhi, India, from March 4 to March 11, 1951.
 
• The event was organized by the Asian Games Federation until 1978, after which the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) took over the organization.
 
• The Asian Games are recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and are the second-largest multi-sport event after the Olympics.
 
 
 
• **Olympic Council of Asia (OCA)**
 
 
• The OCA is a governing body of sports in Asia, responsible for organizing the Asian Games and other regional games.
 
• It was established in 1982 and is headquartered in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
 
• The OCA aims to promote the Olympic movement and sports activities in Asia.
 
• The council also oversees the development and progress of sports across the continent.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi**
 
 
• New Delhi is the capital city of India and one of its largest metropolitan areas.
 
• It has been the host city for many international events, including the first Asian Games in 1951.
 
• New Delhi is known for its rich history, cultural heritage, and as a political and administrative center.
 
• The city has several sports complexes and stadiums that have hosted various national and international sports events.
